pad.cursorHint: With the cursor on, the left stick moves it and A clicks, so faces can be picked without a mouse.
pad.none: No controller seen yet. Plug one in and press any button, the webview only reports a pad after its first press.
pad.usage: Left stick pans, right stick rotates, the triggers zoom. On a Steam Deck, start FundaCAD from Steam so the Deck shows up as a controller; its trackpads keep working as a mouse.
setting.cursorSpeedHint: How fast the left stick moves the cursor while the cursor is on.
setting.deadzoneHint: How far a stick has to move before anything happens, as a share of its travel.
setting.panSpeedHint: How far the left stick moves the view.
setting.rotateSpeedHint: How fast the right stick turns the view.
